raw_response: {"diagnosis": "The 28 duplicated txn_ids in raw_transactions are re-delivered copies that differ only in amount and record_version (v1 and v2), and the silver step keeps both copies. Keeping only the highest record_version per txn_id, and applying the POSTED filter after that dedup, gives one correct row per transaction.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.75, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(r.txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, r.customer_id, CAST(r.merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(r.amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(r.txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(r.txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT * FROM raw_transactions QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY record_version DESC) = 1) r WHERE r.status = 'POSTED';"}}
